name: ecommerce-cart-page
context: Design a shopping cart page displaying line items, quantities, pricing summary, and checkout actions. The audience is shoppers reviewing their selections before purchase. Target platforms: desktop and mobile responsive. Must handle empty cart state, item removal, quantity updates, and promo code input.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json for price columns and summary totals
Apply color.rules.json for discount highlights and removal actions
Use layout.rules.json for cart table on desktop, card list on mobile
Quantity controls must use input with increment/decrement buttons
Remove item action must use confirmation or undo pattern
Empty cart state must use illustration asset and clear CTA

outputCriteria.format: Page layout spec with line item table, summary panel, and empty state
qualityChecks: All color values resolve to semantic tokens
Line item layout handles variable product name lengths
Price summary uses consistent alignment and typography
Empty state provides clear next-step action
accessibilityRequirements: Cart item count announced in page title or heading
Quantity changes reflect updated totals via aria-live
Remove buttons have accessible names including product name
Price summary table uses proper header associations
Promo code input has associated label and error feedback

examples.description: Cart line item row with quantity control and pricing
examples.output:
Molecule: CartLineItem
  Layout: grid(columns: [80px 1fr auto auto auto], gap: var(--space-md), align: center)
  border-bottom: var(--border-subtle)
  padding: var(--space-md) 0
  Children:
    - Atom: Image(size=80px, radius=var(--radius-sm), alt=product-name)
    - Molecule: ProductMeta
        - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.md, color=color.text.primary)
        - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.sm, color=color.text.secondary)
    - Molecule: QuantityControl(min=1, max=99)
        - Atom: Button(icon=minus, variant=ghost, size=sm)
        - Atom: Input(type=number, width=48px, text-align=center)
        - Atom: Button(icon=plus, variant=ghost, size=sm)
    - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.md, weight=strong, color=color.text.primary)
    - Atom: Button(icon=trash, variant=ghost, color=color.feedback.error, aria-label='Remove [product]')
acceptanceCriteria: Uses semantic tokens for all values
Grid adapts to card layout on mobile
